title: "Benchmarks and Format Example"

## Reference example

The [PK Model Selection format example](benchmarks/example-pk-model-selection/index.qmd) demonstrates documentation, metadata, the data dictionary, and task definitions. Each split contains one subject and three concentration observations. These small snippets illustrate the format; they are not a complete, scientifically validated benchmark and have no DOI.

[View the example documentation](benchmarks/example-pk-model-selection/index.qmd) or [browse its data files](https://github.com/AIML-SIG/pmx_benchmarks/tree/main/benchmarks/example-pk-model-selection/data). The files use Git LFS; see the [data download instructions](submission-guide.qmd#large-data-files).

## Community benchmarks

We are inviting submissions. Accepted benchmarks will be listed here with their tasks, documentation, and citation information. See the [scope](scope.qmd) to decide which track fits your work and the [submission guide](submission-guide.qmd) to contribute.
